content.title: Tyson Fury beats Makhmudov in heavyweight boxing comeback – as it happened
content.text: 11 Apr 2026 - 22:28 (22:28 GMT)That’s a wrapOur coverage is ending now. Thanks so much for joining us for an intriguing evening of boxing.After Fury outclassed Makhmudov, the negotiations can now begin for Fury vs Joshua, and hopefully, they can deliver.Al Jazeera will be back on Sunday with more live sporting action, including Chelsea vs Man City in a pivotal Premier League clash. But for now, it’s goodbye from Patrick Keddie and Kevin Hand.11 Apr 2026 - 22:23 (22:23 GMT)Read all about it: Our fight report is liveClick here to read our full report following Fury’s win.11 Apr 2026 - 22:19 (22:19 GMT)Main fight card results Tyson Fury beat Arslanbek Makhmudov via unanimous decision (120-108, 120-108, 119-109) Conor Benn beat Regis Prograis via unanimous decision (98-92, 98-92, 98-92) Richard Riakporhe beat Jeamie Tshikeva via TKO, fifth round Justis Huni beat Frazer Clarke via majority decision (95-95, 96-94, 96-94) 11 Apr 2026 - 22:14 (22:14 GMT)‘I run the game,’ Joshua saysAnthony Joshua has spoken more to Netflix.“I’ll be completely honest. There’s a negotiation you go through. I’ve sat at this table with him many times. In my heart, I would fight Tyson Fury tomorrow, especially after watching that.“It’s not a problem with me fighting. I’m not here to get clout, I’m here to fight. Contracts will be sent over, and you’ll probably see us in the ring more likely.“I’m not here to get in the ring and shout in somebody’s face, I’m not about that. I saw what I saw and know what I’ve got to do when I get in the ring…“Once I’m 100 percent, I’ll be ready. I run the game. Everyone knows I run the game. It’s what I do; I’m very strong.“When I hit Fury, I’ll hurt him bad.”11 Apr 2026 - 22:10 (22:10 GMT)Fury happy to get in 12 rounds with MakhmudovFury says that 16 months out was a long time, but he’s happy to get a “good, sharp” 12 rounds in against a tough opponent.“I just took out the number five-ranked contender in the world with ease,” he says.11 Apr 2026 - 22:08 (22:08 GMT)Fury dedicates victory to Ricky HattonFury says he dedicates the fight to his friend, Ricky Hatton, the great British boxer who recently passed away.“May he rest in peace forever,” Fury shouts, before leading a chant of “There’s only one Ricky Hatton”.11 Apr 2026 - 22:07 (22:07 GMT)Fury and Joshua trade barbsFury gets frustrated as Joshua refuses to come into the ring.“Come on, you big s***house, are you going to fight or not?” he shouts.Someone has handed Joshua a microphone, and he accuses Fury of being a “clout chaser”.“I’ve never had a problem getting in the ring with you. I punched you out when we were kids, and I’ll punch you out again,” Joshua says as Fury shouts at him from the ring.Joshua adds: “With all due respect, tonight is your night, and you know I’ll [be] in that ring across from you in due time. You aren’t going to tell me what to do. I’ve been chasing you for the last 10 years. When you’re ready, you come and see me… I’m the boss. You work for me.”It would definitely have been more fun if Joshua had just gotten in the ring.Fury tells Joshua to stop running from him.11 Apr 2026 - 22:01 (22:01 GMT)Fury says he wants to fight Joshua nextSaudi boxing supremo Turki Alalshikh speaks before Fury and confirms that the Gypsy King will fight Antony Joshua next. Then he hands the microphone over to Fury.“Next, I want to give you the fight you’ve all been waiting for – I want you, AJ, Anthony Joshua,” he says, addressing Joshua in the crowd. “Let’s give the fight fans what they want – the Battle of Britain!… Do you accept my challenge?”Joshua responds by tapping his chest, but doesn’t say anything.Tyson Fury celebrates winning his fight against Arslanbek Makhmudov [Andrew Couldridge/Reuters]Get instant alerts and updates based on your interests. Be the first to know when big stories happen.11 Apr 2026 - 21:57 (21:57 GMT)Fury beats Makhmudov by unanimous decisionThe judges score it 120-108, 120-108, 119-109 to Fury.Fury endured a couple of hair-raising rounds at the start of the fight as Makhmudov mounted a crude assault, but the Russian soon faded as Fury took charge with his sublime boxing skills.Before the judges had even given their scores, Fury was trying to convince Joshua to get into the ring, but he defers, saying, “It’s your night”.Britain’s Tyson Fury (C) celebrates after his victory over Russia’s Arslanbek Makhmudov [Henry Nicholls/AFP]11 Apr 2026 - 21:54 (21:54 GMT)Fury vs Makhmudov: Round 12Fury is utterly in charge as the last round begins.Makhmudov does land a rather tired right overhand, but Fury is stepping back, and it only grazes him.Fury lands some more uppercuts with ease, left and right, while Makhmudov generally looks happy to clinch and survive.Makhmudov has taken a huge accumulation of punches now, and he is drained.Into the final minute, Fury whips a left into Makhmudov’s gut, as the crowd roars on Fury as he looks for the finish.He can’t find it before the bell goes, but he’s surely won handily on points and has set up a super fight with Anthony Joshua.Tyson Fury with Arslanbek Makhmudov after winning the fight [Andrew Couldridge/Reuters]
